svg.text: K8b Press cup — T turns a screw, food is pushed through a die
All force jobs (dicing, ricing, garlic) happen in one cup on the turning hub; the force stays inside the cup.
13 Nm on T → 3 kN on the piston (T = F × 4.3 mm)
reaction 13 Nm → 65 N on the rear wall via a 200 mm arm
onion in 40 s · 1 kg vegetables in 3 min
A SECTION THROUGH THE PRESS CUP
pan on the neighbouring hob zone
wire bow sweeps the die face
B TOP VIEW: WHERE THE TORQUE GOES
The piston force (3 kN) closes inside the cup;
only 65 N reaches the tub wall, none the puck.
C DIES ON TOP OF THE CUP
1/2 Dicing: onion halves in the cup, grid on top. T turns the screw, the piston rises, the bow sweeps the dice into the spout and the pan.
2/2 Mash: boiled potatoes in their skins are pushed through the 3 mm ricer; the skins stay below the die as a cake.
